reasons.plausibility: Tungsten solid-solution strengthening in TiVNbTa is consistent with known refractory alloy behavior, though detailed compositional optimization might be non-trivial.
reasons.testability: Incremental W doping and mechanical testing at 1273 K provide a clear, feasible path to validate or refute the proposed mechanism and performance gains.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a pressing issue—improving high-temperature performance of an intermediate alloy—offering a plausible and experimentally accessible intervention.
